benchmarks.name: Dapp Lifecycle
benchmarks.desc: Build, test, secure and audit onchain applications. Artifacts are executed, not read: hidden Foundry tests run against what the model leaves behind.

tracks.name: Build
tracks.desc: Implement a dapp or protocol from a written spec. Hidden Foundry tests decide.

tracks.name: Test
tracks.desc: Write a suite that catches real regressions. Seeded variants must die.

tracks.name: Secure
tracks.desc: Fix a live vulnerability without breaking behavior. A hidden exploit decides.

tracks.name: Audit
tracks.desc: Find what is actually wrong. False positives count against you.

evals.title: Findings report for a small DeFi system
evals.summary: Audit an oracle, a lending pool and a rewards contract with three seeded issues. Report findings as JSON; false positives count against you.

source.mistake: Readers that miss access-control holes and precision loss, and reports padded with issues that do not exist.

evals.title: Yield vault with correct share accounting
evals.summary: Implement a 6-decimal share vault from spec. Hidden tests check tracked accounting, rounding direction, and that donations do not move the share price.

source.mistake: Using the token balance as totalAssets (a direct transfer moves the share price), rounding deposits up or withdrawals down, and minting shares without pulling the asset.
source.seen_in: real agent output on vault and ERC-4626 tasks

evals.title: Crowdfund with deadline, hard cap and refunds
evals.summary: Implement an ETH crowdfund from spec. Hidden tests hit the deadline boundary, the hard cap, direct sends, owner withdrawal and double refunds.

source.mistake: Off-by-one deadline checks, letting contributions exceed the cap, missing owner/deadline guards on withdrawal, and refunds that zero state after the transfer.
source.seen_in: real agent output on crowdfund and escrow tasks

evals.title: Fix a reentrant withdrawal in a live pool
evals.summary: A live ETH pool sends before zeroing stake. Fix it; a hidden exploit must fail and hidden behavior tests must still pass.

source.mistake: Sending ETH before zeroing state, and partial fixes (a guard cleared early, a solvency check instead of an ordering fix).
source.seen_in: real agent output on reentrancy fixes

evals.title: Write tests that kill every seeded regression
evals.summary: Pin the behavior of a small token. The suite must be green as shipped and fail against five hidden single-behavior variants.

source.mistake: Happy-path-only test suites that assert on internals and miss ownership, allowance and supply-accounting regressions.
source.seen_in: real agent output on test-writing tasks
